question: Does deleting distinct source returns at a fixed center in the native first 0.2 m / 16-neighbor branch damage frozen grounding, and does the conditional missing-max estimate repair it?
inputs: Only same-platform source TRAIN point clouds, original descriptions and frozen checkpoints. Source GT is available to the evaluator after prediction sealing. No target platform is evaluated under another source checkpoint. No FINAL. No optimizer, BN updates, checkpoint editing or extra expert.
panel: All registered 160 Waymo, 64 Drone, 160 Quad natural source-monitor rows, including every thin region and fallback. The historical 192 exposed diagnostic rows are a named subset. Separate recording and raw scan hashes from all 640 fitting rows of each source. Report source/recording counts and prior exposure. Source-own is different from a cross-platform target evaluation.
fixed_inputs: Dataset sampler returns a raw row index for each of the 16384 slots. Capture actual CUDA FPS and ball-query indices and use these raw IDs for uniqueness and center inclusion. Hold all 2048 centers, raw LiDAR sample, sentence, 256 query seed indices, six decoder positions, and all 16 PCA boxes exactly fixed. Reproduce the archived frozen K16 scores and decisions. Read scores as frozen K16 joint score plus change in native first-noun log odds. Preserve the unmodified v1 winner as a separate baseline.
intervention: Replace only the first 32 channels at the input to the native aggregation Conv1d after max pooling, leaving the other radius untouched. Artificial deletion applies only to saturated neighborhoods having 16 distinct physical IDs including the sampled center. Keep the center plus a uniform without-replacement draw to n=4 or n=8, using both fixed masks 211 and 947. Add a structured deletion retaining the center and three non-center returns nearest the sensor. The physical retention sets are shared across channels. Unaffected centers retain their original FP32 tensors.
first_gate: Report the changed rank/margins and all threshold crossings for each mask. Continue to unlabeled source-table fitting when full-to-n4 deletion makes at least one originally correct Acc50 choice miss in BOTH fixed random masks (they may affect different rows). A systematic accuracy decline is a separate claim requiring average net harms. If neither mask can damage final choices reproducibly, stop before making a table; include all negative findings and original opportunities.
calibration_if_eligible: For each single-source model use 128 fitting frames selected deterministically round-robin by source recording, ordered by SHA256 of raw scan hash. Track the full 16 unique returns with the center present. B=32, zero separately, positive-activation quantiles from the selected source full neighborhoods before examining deletion outcomes. Use exact center-preserving rank probabilities to sum residuals, separately for each n and channel. Compare original max, count/channel-only mean residual, OLS affine residual given current max and n, and binned mean residual. All three use the same per-count/channel observed value support; identity outside observed support, n<=1, n=16, empty cell or center absent. No clipping of affine predictions beyond the fit support rule. Check tables on independent recordings, not fitting risk.
confirmation_if_eligible: On all 384 frozen K16 source-monitor decisions compare untouched natural observations, both n4 deletions and structured n4 deletion, with identical maps for constants, affine, binned and binned with count assignments cycled among eligible physical centers. Two n8 masks remain dose controls from the first stage. On truly natural sparse centers feature recovery truth is unavailable; measure task behavior directly. Compare artificial deletion MSE only where the full activation is measured. Preserve the independent 192 diagnostic failures in every applicable count. No target expansion in this study.
metrics: Strict original seven-value IoU>0.25, >0.50, mIoU, rescues/harms vs own untreated and vs undamaged when relevant, erroneous descent from >0.50 to zero, score margin of best passing candidate vs original winner, distinct winner count, within-slate recoverable errors. Compare directions separately and equal-source mean. Paired resampling by source recording; sparse recording counts disclosed. Native-full parity, duplicate-only and saturated identity checks, missing-center frequency; no invented ground truth for sensor occlusions.
adoption: If the primary conditional table cannot net rescue originally wrong natural Acc50 on the predefined panel, or performs similarly with counts reassigned, do not promote it. Compare its necessity with the constant and affine estimates. Hold the current simplified v1 in production.
